scope: Mobile manipulation data/benchmarks/assets; online primary-source research only; no demonstration or mesh payloads downloaded.

status_definitions.A: Best near-term MuJoCo state/asset candidates; no success implied
status_definitions.B: Useful simulation/source but adapter, generation, physics or licensing gap
status_definitions.C: Motion/perception/system/research source; missing object-state/physics or not released

profiles.name: RoboCasa365 and earlier RoboCasa
profiles.embodiment: Panda arm, Omron mobile base, parallel gripper
profiles.base_state: Named base position/rotation in modality metadata; exact world/base frame must follow episode configuration. Native state enables authoritative reconstruction.
profiles.hand_state: Gripper qpos, closure action, arm end-effector pose/action; base motion and control-mode actions.
profiles.object_state: Native extras contain raw MuJoCo states plus episode MJCF. Map joints/bodies from compiled model, never fixed tail offsets.
profiles.scene_assets: model.xml.gz and ep_meta.json identify fixtures, objects, layouts/styles; resolve referenced mesh/texture assets from pinned RoboCasa.
profiles.scenario_coverage: 365 tasks; paper separates 220 requiring mobility and 145 stationary. Cabinets, appliances, dishes, food, containers; 30k human pretraining demonstrations plus generated data.
profiles.access: Public official downloader supports task/split/source selection. Download a native task package retaining extras. Exact package bytes were not verified here.
profiles.license: Code MIT; data/assets CC-BY-4.0 with upstream asset notices.
profiles.limitations: Version 1.0.1 raises evaluation horizons 1.5x. A LeRobot mirror lacking extras cannot support object replay. Check arm/controller timing and mobile-base constraints when replacing Panda with Reachy.
profiles.lineage: RoboCasa versions, alternate cameras, LeRobot conversions and MimicGen expansions are related releases; record human seed lineage.
profiles.recommended_next_step: First choice: one counter-to-cabinet or counter-to-counter mobile episode, its extras, and only referenced assets; verify base/object poses against simulator FK before Reachy physics.
unknowns: Version 1.0.1 raises evaluation horizons 1.5x. A LeRobot mirror lacking extras cannot support object replay. Check arm/controller timing and mobile-base constraints when replacing Panda with Reachy.

profiles.name: BiGym
profiles.embodiment: Bimanual floating-base humanoid with parallel grippers
profiles.base_state: Floating-base control is explicit; it is not a wheeled nonholonomic base. Recover full pose from pinned MuJoCo model/state during replay.
profiles.hand_state: Bimanual joint-position demonstrations; gripper actions, arm proprioception and optional RGB/depth observations.
profiles.object_state: Lightweight demonstrations carry actions and reset seed, not a verified per-frame all-object state table. Replay and log MuJoCo bodies/joints.
profiles.scene_assets: MJCF robot, household props, kitchen assets and collisions in source tree.
profiles.scenario_coverage: 40 tasks including dishwashing, cupboards, plates and kitchen cleanup; exclude target-reaching-only tasks for this repository.
profiles.access: Public v0.9.0 demonstrations.zip: 123, 362, 114 bytes. DemoStore.get_demos can auto-download the entire ZIP; use explicit fetch and pin release.
profiles.license: Code Apache-2.0; asset notices include CC0, CC-BY-4.0 and CC-BY-NC-4.0. Demo-specific grant should be checked alongside release.
profiles.limitations: Upstream warns that some demonstrations do not succeed on replay. Preserve failed playback. Floating base may prescribe motion unrealistic for Reachy wheels.
profiles.lineage: Former chernyadev repository redirects to NeuracoreAI; cached observation/frequency variants are the same underlying demos.
profiles.recommended_next_step: Choose MovePlate or a cupboard manipulation demo, replay its native actions, export complete object state, then attempt Reachy contact without copying object states during validation.
unknowns: Upstream warns that some demonstrations do not succeed on replay. Preserve failed playback. Floating base may prescribe motion unrealistic for Reachy wheels.

profiles.name: BEHAVIOR-1K / OmniGibson 2025 and 2026 releases
profiles.base_state: 2026 LeRobot observation.state[0:3] is robot-local base velocity, not global SE(2); raw simulator state supports world pose recovery.
profiles.hand_state: 2026 state width 61, action width 23, arm/gripper/trunk positions and velocities; three RGB/depth cameras.
profiles.object_state: Raw HDF5 state/state_size plus initial scene information and add/remove transitions. Variable-length serialized state cannot be read using MuJoCo qpos offsets.
profiles.scene_assets: USD geometry/material/physics and scene JSON; particle/material/semantic states exceed rigid-body MJCF. Many assets are encrypted under third-party licenses.
profiles.scenario_coverage: 2026: 20k demos, 100 full-length tasks, seven challenge scenes; benchmark overall has 1, 000 activities. 2025 raw release is distinct version lineage, not automatically independent.
profiles.access: 2026 raw listing: 1, 440, 087, 423, 774 bytes, 20, 000 HDF5s. Smallest listed HDF5 667, 124 bytes. LeRobot documentation: 3.27 TB. Public metadata and raw listing accessible.
profiles.license: 2026 LeRobot card says MIT; raw repository has no card license in API. Code MIT does not license encrypted ShapeNet/TurboSquid assets for arbitrary redistribution.
profiles.limitations: Maintainer confirms assisted grasping in collection and evaluation. July 2026 corrected base velocity frame; August corrected joint velocities. Evaluation docs require v 3.9.3 while baseline page still names v 3.9.2. Pin code and data independently.
profiles.lineage: Deduplicate 2025/2026, raw/LeRobot, rerenders and language annotations by original trajectory identifiers. Do not add 10k and 20k without overlap audit.
profiles.recommended_next_step: Use bounded raw state inspection first. Start with rigid pick/carry/place and export legally usable geometry. Replan grasp under physical contacts; assisted source success is not validation.
unknowns: Maintainer confirms assisted grasping in collection and evaluation. July 2026 corrected base velocity frame; August corrected joint velocities. Evaluation docs require v 3.9.3 while baseline page still names v 3.9.2. Pin code and data independently.

profiles.license: Website CC-BY-SA is not a dataset license. Code, source demonstration and inherited BEHAVIOR asset grants need separate inspection.
profiles.limitations: The older momagen-rss.github.io page still says code coming soon; current momagen.github.io links the public repository. Do not infer source-data availability or physical-grasp fidelity from code availability.

profiles.recommended_next_step: Inspect the generator recorder and grasp settings, then plan one source task with explicit base reachability and visibility constraints. Verify seed data access and asset license before installation.

profiles.name: Galaxea Open-World Dataset
profiles.base_state: The published schema records observation.state.chassis[3] positions, chassis.velocities[3], and chassis.imu[10]. The reference frame, pose convention and odometry calibration are not established by the card. action.chassis.velocities[6] is a commanded twist.
profiles.hand_state: Left/right arm position and velocity vectors have six values each; torso vectors have four. Each gripper observation ranges from 0 closed to 100 open. Each end-effector pose has position plus quaternion (seven values).
profiles.object_state: No per-frame all-object 6D or dynamics assets in published schema.

profiles.name: TidyBot++ / tidybot2
profiles.resource_kind: mobile robot demonstrations + MuJoCo collection environment
profiles.embodiment: Holonomic mobile base, single arm and parallel gripper
profiles.base_state: base_pose[3] is episode-relative SE(2); the recorder checks that the initial base pose is approximately zero.
profiles.hand_state: Observations include arm_pos, arm_quat and gripper_pos. The simulator changes MuJoCo wxyz quaternions to xyzw; the dataset converter encodes action orientation as axis-angle.
profiles.object_state: The inspected recorder and HDF5 converter retain observations and actions, but no general MuJoCo full-state or object-qpos time series.
profiles.scene_assets: The MuJoCo model and a cube pickup environment are provided.
profiles.scenario_coverage: Ground-level cube pickup sample demonstrations, with separate real household examples.
profiles.access: The official README links sim-v1.tar.gz on Dropbox and converted HDF5 data. Payload size was not verified.
profiles.license: Code MIT, verified from the repository license; the sample dataset grant was not separately established.
profiles.limitations: The upstream example randomizes the cube at reset, so open-loop action playback is not expected to succeed every time. Its recorder keeps successful recordings; this repository must also preserve failed attempts.
profiles.lineage: The raw sim-v 1 collection and its robomimic HDF5 conversion are the same recordings.
profiles.recommended_next_step: Use the offline MuJoCo environment as a generator and add complete initial state, object trajectories and asset provenance. Do not label missing original cube poses as measured.
unknowns: The upstream example randomizes the cube at reset, so open-loop action playback is not expected to succeed every time. Its recorder keeps successful recordings; this repository must also preserve failed attempts.
